title_en: Fall 2026 Recognition of Graduate Credits Earned at Another University Before Admission
summary: Graduate students who wish to have credits earned at another university's graduate school before admission recognised must submit the required documents to the department office by 5:00 p.m. on Monday, 21 September 2026. Recognition is limited by degree programme, grade, time since completion and subject similarity.
applies_to: Graduate students who wish to have credits earned at another university's graduate school before admission to this university recognised. Students are asked to apply in their first semester after admission. Undergraduate courses are not eligible.

dates.what: Deadline for submission of application documents

steps: Read Attachment 01 (붙임01) for detailed course explanations and criteria.
Complete Attachment 02 (붙임02, application form), including your own signature and your academic advisor's signature (or seal); both are mandatory.
Complete Attachment 03 (붙임03, credit recognition table), leaving the department head (학과(부)장) field blank.
Obtain a transcript from your previous university; for a foreign university, provide an English transcript and evidence of lecture hours (e.g., timetable, calculation of completed hours).
Prepare documents showing the courses are in the same major: syllabi and major/course overviews (submit only the essential parts).
Prepare proof of enrolment at your previous university, such as a certificate of completion or certificate of enrolment.
Submit all documents (items 1 to 4) to the staff member in charge at the department office (Building 301, Room 319) by 5:00 p.m., Monday, 21 September 2026.
translation:
Fall 2026 Application for Recognition of Credits Earned at Another University's Graduate School Before Admission

1. Eligibility
Graduate students who wish to have credits earned at another university's graduate school before admission to this university recognised.
※ For smooth academic administration, please apply in your first semester after admission.
※ For details, see the attachment (Attachment 01). The content of the attachments was not read; please refer to the original notice.

2. Submission of Application Documents
A. Period: until 5:00 p.m., Monday, 21 September 2026 (~ 2026. 9. 21.(월) 오후 5시까지)
B. Submit the application documents to the staff member in charge at the department office (Building 301, Room 319).
C. Required documents: all of items 1) to 4) must be submitted.
1) The attachments (Attachment 02 [붙임02] and Attachment 03 [붙임03])
※ Attachment 02: your signature and your academic advisor's signature (or seal) are mandatory.
※ Attachment 03: leave the department head (학과(부)장) field blank.
2) Transcript from your previous university
※ For a foreign university: (1) an English transcript and (2) supporting evidence showing lecture hours (timetable, calculation of completed hours, etc.)
3) Documents confirming the same major: syllabi, major overview and course overviews (submit only the essential parts)
4) Proof of affiliation with your previous university: certificate of completion, certificate of enrolment, etc.

3. Recognition of Credits
A. Course credits earned before admission to a master's or doctoral programme at this university, in a master's or doctoral programme of the same level in the same or a similar major at another university, may be recognised as completed credits only for the same or similar courses with a grade of B0 or higher completed within the past 10 years, up to 6 credits for a master's programme, 9 credits for a doctoral programme and 15 credits for an integrated master's-doctoral programme.
※ Undergraduate courses: not eligible.
B. However, a student who earned credits in an integrated master's-doctoral programme at another university before admission and enters a master's programme at this university may have up to 6 credits recognised.

Programme before admission / Programme at this university / Credits recognised:
- Master's programme / Master's programme / up to 6 credits
- Master's programme / Integrated master's-doctoral programme / up to 6 credits
- Doctoral programme / Doctoral programme / up to 9 credits
- Doctoral programme / Integrated master's-doctoral programme / up to 9 credits
- Integrated master's-doctoral programme / Master's programme / up to 6 credits
- Integrated master's-doctoral programme / Integrated master's-doctoral programme / up to 15 credits

C. Credit recognition procedure
1) Recommendation by the academic advisor → Department Academic Committee → College Academic Committee → approval by the President.
2) Courses approved for credit recognition are entered in the academic record as completion of the same or similar course at this university, but the grades are not included in the calculation of the grade point average.
D. Students who have received 'recognition of credits earned at another graduate school' (타교 대학원 수학학점 인정) may not take the same or similar course again at this university.

- Please refer to the attachments.
- Enquiries: the department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.

[Attachment 03] Credit recognition table, 2026-2 (HWP)
